description: Gossip directory vectors for protocol version 1 (gossip-frame in spec/transport.cddl, peer-advert in spec/transport.cddl). The top-level vectors are the gossip frames the scenarios deliver, round-tripped like any other file. The `gossip_directory` section holds `identities` (the fixed Ed25519 keys every advert is signed with), `extension_validation` (the key bags a gossip update may carry, each accepted or refused for one named reason), `directory_scenarios` (frames delivered in order, each step recording what became of every advert and the directory held afterwards, as devices and snapshot times in first-heard order; a scenario with `rust_only` pins a bound only the Rust session applies) and `self_adverts` (the advert a session sends: its device, time, extension keys and topology, whose signature a consumer verifies). Every list's size is in `counts`.
